Which exchanges are open

Source: R/fct_markets.R
market_status.Rd

For each exchange of the indices: its local time, and whether it is open, at lunch or closed, with when that changes, from its regular sessions on weekdays. Holidays are not known, so on a holiday an exchange shows as open.

Usage

market_status(now = Sys.time())

Arguments

now

The time to judge, now by default.

Value

A data frame with a row per exchange, from west to east: exchange, local_time (such as "10:42"), state ("open", "lunch" or "closed"), text, when that changes (such as "closes 16:00", "reopens 12:30" or "opens Mon 09:30"), hours, the regular sessions of the day (such as "09:00–11:30, 12:30–15:30"), time_zone and indices, the labels of its indices joined by commas.

Examples

market_status()
#>        exchange local_time  state            text                    hours           time_zone                                                                 indices
#> 1   Mexico City      12:55 closed opens Mon 08:30              08:30–15:00 America/Mexico_City                                                              IPC Mexico
#> 2       Toronto      13:55 closed opens Mon 09:30              09:30–16:00     America/Toronto                                                       S&P/TSX Composite
#> 3      New York      13:55 closed opens Mon 09:30              09:30–16:00    America/New_York S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq Composite, NYSE Composite, Russell 2000, VIX
#> 4     São Paulo      15:55 closed opens Mon 10:00              10:00–18:00   America/Sao_Paulo                                                                 Bovespa
